# Data pack sample

A small cut of the real-estate data pack (`export/`, not in git; snapshot SNAP-20260630-01, DW 3.1.0):
the first 60 units of The Sapphire 1, SAPPHIRE1-16.231 (TC-01) and the first 20 units of The Beverly
(TC-04). Unit-grain tables keep only those units; reference tables are whole. Same file names and
headers as `export/`, so any reader of the data pack reads this folder too.
